His file (inversed.ru/Ascension/Heilbronn_S13.txt) scores 0.027019272239114 as published (header 2.70192722391139E-2, matches our evaluator to 7e-18; tables show the truncation 0.0270+); one epigraph polish refines it in-basin to 0.027019916669111 (+6.4e-7).
